root_cause.error: sqlite3.OperationalError: unable to open database file on the first query of UI read connections
root_cause.mechanism: Scheduled jobs run the checkout with uv Python and bundled SQLite 3.50.4, which deletes the -wal/-shm files when its last connection closes. CMAIL runs pyenv Python on macOS SQLite 3.51.0, whose file-level read-only (mode=ro) connections cannot recreate them: SQLITE_CANTOPEN, errno 2.
root_cause.rate_before_fix: 60 in the first 8 hours of the labels build

evidence.deterministic_cross_library_repro: bundled-SQLite writer closes -> WAL files removed -> macOS SQLite mode=ro read fails; mode=rw + query_only read succeeds and recreates them
